newsitems.title: 24 Hours Left Until Titanic Escape Simulator Launches
newsitems.author: developer3003
newsitems.contents: The final 24 hours have begun.Titanic Escape Simulator™ launches on Steam tomorrow, August 24, 2026.Very soon, players will step aboard the RMS Titanic and experience a cinematic first-person adventure filled with mystery, exploration, puzzles, danger, and survival.Before the disaster begins, you will investigate suspicious events, search for hidden clues, explore restricted areas, and uncover secrets hidden deep within the ship.But once the iceberg strikes, everything changes.Water rises. Lights fail. Corridors flood. Paths collapse. The ship begins to tilt.Every second will matter.Thank you to everyone who has followed the project, supported us, and added the game to their wishlist.Titanic Escape Simulator™ launches tomorrow on Steam.Wishlist now and prepare to step aboard.The clock is ticking. The water is rising. History is inevitable.

newsitems.title: The Wait Is Over: Release Date Announced
newsitems.author: gamepoc
newsitems.contents: The Wait Is Over — Release Date AnnouncedThe wait is finally over.We are excited to officially announce that Titanic Escape Simulator will launch on August 24, 2026.After months of development, planning, and community support, we can now share the date when players will step aboard the RMS Titanic and experience a story-driven adventure filled with mystery, exploration, puzzles, danger, and survival.In Titanic Escape Simulator, you will explore the ship during its final voyage, investigate suspicious events, uncover hidden secrets, and follow a dark mystery through luxury cabins, restricted corridors, and the lower decks of the legendary ocean liner.But when the iceberg strikes, everything changes.The investigation becomes a desperate race against time as water floods the ship, paths collapse, the deck begins to tilt, and every decision matters.Release DateTitanic Escape Simulator launches August 24, 2026.We are incredibly thankful to everyone who has followed the project, added the game to their wishlist, and supported us along the way.The countdown has officially begun.The clock is ticking. The water is rising. History is inevitable.
